status_note: LR sensitivity test at the confirmed 2-epoch optimum: LR 2e-5 -> 1e-5 on the same 2691-record fuzzy-recovered corpus. Negative result -- lower LR under-trains (final epoch loss 0.0333 vs 0.0162 at 2e-5; schema validity drops to 0.8056). 72-rec hybrid F1 0.6671 vs iter-2's 0.6745. Brackets the LR dimension: 2e-5 (the V2/V3 default) is confirmed near-optimal.
